# Planting calendar

## March

- Sow chillies indoors
- Chit early potatoes

## April

- Sow [[Tomatoes]] under glass, 18 °C or warmer
- Direct sow carrots once the soil is workable

## May

- Plant out [[Beans]] after the last frost
- Harden off the tomatoes
